name: Tusk PHP
notes: This repository. Build it first with `make build`. Holds its index in memory only, so there is no cache directory to reset.

name: Intelephense
notes: Run without a licence key, so only free-tier features are measured. Premium adds rename, code actions and finding implementations.

name: Phpactor
notes: Indexes lazily in the background; it publishes no 'done' signal, which is why readiness is probed rather than listened for.

name: php-lsp (Rust)
notes: Rust server by jorgsowa. Speaks stdio with no arguments. Configuration is available through initializationOptions (phpVersion, excludePaths, diagnostics) but is left at defaults here so it auto-detects the PHP version from composer.json like the others.

name: PHPantom
notes: Rust server. Reads an optional .phpantom.toml from the workspace; none is added here, so it runs on its defaults.

name: Psalm language server
notes: Disabled by default: it refuses to start without a psalm.xml in the workspace, and it is a static analyser with a language-server front end rather than an editor-first server. Enable it by adding a psalm.xml to the workspace and setting disabled to false.
